description: This PHP source file defines the AwsCredentials class within the AWS\CRT\Auth namespace, which represents a set of AWS credentials including access key, secret key, session token, and expiration time. The class handles creation, validation, and resource management of AWS credentials using underlying native resources.

classes.name: AwsCredentials
classes.description: Represents a set of AWS credentials including access key, secret key, optional session token, and expiration time. Handles resource management and validation of credentials.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Provides default values for AWS credentials options such as empty strings and zero expiration.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Allows read access to credentials properties via magic getter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AwsCredentials object, initializes properties from options, validates required fields, and sets up native credentials resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases native credential resources when the object is destroyed.
